name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Operations | Multi-Channel Campaign Execution, QA, Lifecycle Journeys & Coordination
summary: Marketing operations specialist who keeps campaigns moving from request to launch and catches problems before they ship. I build and QA email and SMS journeys covering onboarding, reminders, reactivation, and review requests, keep deliverability above 99%, and build the landing pages behind them. I manage many workstreams at once (up to 25 concurrent launches at Wix), coordinate across teams, and use automation and AI to take repetitive work off the plate.

experience.title: Email & Lifecycle Marketing Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Build and QA email and SMS journeys across a 20+ workflow lifecycle system: onboarding nurture, booking confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, reactivation, and review requests.
Set up sending domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and warm-up, holding deliverability above 99%, and build monitoring that catches broken automation before members see it.
Build landing pages and write member-facing copy in plain language; published 18 articles explaining technical topics for non-technical readers.
Use automation and AI (n8n, Make, Zapier, LLM APIs) to take repetitive steps off the plate, and track campaign results in GA4 and CRM dashboards.

bullets: Produced multi-touch email sequences, landing pages, and conversion copy for client campaigns, and reported on conversion KPIs.
